text:
maya: Noticed a confusing billing path when using the Console 'Run as' SA feature — selected project gets ignored and the charge lands on the SA owner org. Quick repro below.
maya: Repro: Console -> Try API -> Run as SA sa-reporter@acme -> choose project=proj-insights -> run -> dashboard shows spike on org-acme.
maya: Ingress headers captured: `Authorization: Bearer ...; X-Run-As: sa-reporter; X-Console-Project: proj-insights; X-Org: org-acme`
raj: Router trace (sanitized):
```
[2026-05-05T10:11:01Z] req=req_0xbed claims={"sa":"sa-reporter","effective_project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=no_effective_project
```
carmen: Quick theory: our gateway strips X-Console-Project for impersonation routes due to the stricter header allowlist we added. If the token doesn't have a claim for effective_project router falls back to SA owner org.
maya: I can repro locally; console sends the header, gateway drops it.
raj: Short-term patch: add X-Console-Project to gateway allowlist for impersonation routes behind a feature flag `authz:preserve-console-project`. Long-term: embed `effective_project` in tokens at mint time (keygen) after validating project membership. Router will then prefer token claim.
carmen: Telemetry ask: add `billing_source` enum to quota events with values token_claim/header/sa_owner. Also add `ui_prompt_shown` boolean so we can measure how often UX would have prevented this.
billing: Please include a detection query: impersonation requests where billing_source=sa_owner over the last 7 days. We'll use that to scope credits. Also export a sample of request ids.
ops-bot: deploy: gateway canary v2.25 scheduled 23:00 PDT. Add feature flag `authz:preserve-console-project`.
maya: UX: if selected SA has no default project, show a small inline banner in Console: "Requests will be billed to org-acme unless you pick a project or set a default on this service account." Link to doc. Reduces support noise.
raj: Security note: when embedding effective_project at mint, validate caller's membership for the chosen project and audit log minted token -> user -> project. Also limit ephemeral token TTL (e.g., 10m).
carmen: Plan: 1) hotfix gateway allowlist PR (fast, review + canary). 2) keygen change to attach `effective_project` claim + validation (PR, tests). 3) router telemetry change to add `billing_source`. 4) Console banner + docs. 5) Canary rollout behind `authz:embed-project-claim`.
maya: Can we also add an internal-only debug header `X-Force-Project` usable in staging so SRE can test fix paths without UI changes? Make it gated by `authz:force-project-debug`.
ops-bot: reminder: include rollback playbook in PR description and tag #support #billing in rollout ticket.
billing: Standby to run detection and coordinate credits once telemetry lands. If detected affected accounts > 15mins worth of org-charged traffic, escalate to leadership.
raj: I'll open the gateway PR now, ETA 2h for reviews. Carmen will start the router telemetry PR. Maya please draft the console banner copy and support blurb.
maya: Drafting banner now, will post shortly. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:
